scheme_name: HDFC Multi Cap Fund Direct Growth
exit_load: The HDFC Multi Cap Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹100. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹100. Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year.
tax_treatment: Equity taxation applies: LTCG taxed at 12.5% above ₹1.25 Lakh; STCG taxed at 20%.
statement_download_process: Capital gains statements and account statements can be downloaded via HDFC MF portal, CAMS, or MFCentral.
